title: Why does subtracting a negative number add?
examples: Why is 5 minus minus 3 equal to 8?
Why do two minuses make a plus?

explain.say: Let us start with something you know. 5 take away 3 is 2. On the number line, taking away 3 means 3 hops to the left. See the hops? You land on 2.

draw.text: Why does subtracting a negative number add?

explain.say: Now look at 5 plus minus 3. Adding a negative also moves you left. So 5 plus minus 3 lands on 2 as well. Same hops, same answer. Do you see why?
Here is the key. Taking away is the opposite of adding. Adding minus 3 goes left, so taking away minus 3 must go right. Watch: 3 hops to the right, and you land on 8.
Let us try one more. Minus 2 minus minus 6. Taking away minus 6 means 6 hops right. Start at minus 2. Count with me: you land on 4. Did you get 4 too?

Great work! Think of money. If Ade owes 3 naira and his friend takes the debt away, Ade is 3 naira better off. Wow: Brahmagupta wrote this same rule in India almost 1,400 years ago. Can you do 1 minus minus 9?

faq.a: Subtracting is the opposite of adding. Whatever way adding moves you on the number line, subtracting moves you the other way.

faq.q: What does adding a negative do?
faq.a: Adding a negative number moves you left on the number line, so the total gets smaller. 7 plus minus 2 is 5.

faq.q: Why does taking away a debt make you richer?
faq.a: A debt is a negative amount of money. If someone takes away a debt of 3 naira, you are 3 naira better off. So taking away a negative adds.
asks: How is subtracting a negative like cancelling a debt?

faq.q: Do two minuses always make a plus?
faq.a: Only when a minus sign sits right next to a negative number, like 5 minus minus 3. In 5 minus 3 minus 2 the minuses are separate, and the answer is 0.
asks: Do two negatives always make a positive?

faq.a: It is the same as minus 2 plus 6, which is 4. Start at minus 2 and hop 6 to the right.

facts: Brahmagupta wrote in 628 CE that a debt taken away from zero becomes a fortune.
On many calculators the subtract key and the negative sign key are different buttons.

quiz.why: Taking away minus 2 means 2 hops right, so 4 becomes 6.

wrong.1: 2 ignores the second minus and does 4 minus 2.
wrong.2: Minus 6 mixes up the direction and the sign.

quiz.say: Which is the same as 3 minus minus 7?
quiz.why: Taking away a negative is the same as adding, so it is 3 plus 7, which is 10.

wrong.1: 3 minus 7 forgets that the 7 was negative.
wrong.2: This changes the sign of the wrong number.
